info.title: KNEX Valet Client API
info.description: This API is designed for clients of the KNEX valet service. It provides endpoints for managing user profiles, vehicles, and valet tickets.

bearerAuth.description: A Firebase Authentication ID token must be provided as a Bearer token.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: An API key may be required for some endpoints.

id.description: The unique identifier for the user profile. This is generated by the system and is read-only.

uid.description: The Firebase Authentication user ID. This is read-only.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the profile was created. Read-only.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the profile was last updated. Read-only.

id.description: Unique identifier for the vehicle. Read-only.

user_client_id.description: The ID of the client who owns the vehicle.

VehicleCreation.description: Represents the data needed to create a vehicle.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ticket. Read-only.

user_client_id.description: The ID of the client associated with the ticket.

vehicle_id.description: The ID of the vehicle associated with the ticket.

status.description: The current status of the ticket.

location_id.description: The ID of the location where the ticket was issued.

notes.description: Any notes related to the ticket.
notes.example: Vehicle has a scratch on the rear bumper.

pin.description: The PIN for a provisional ticket.

ProvisionalTicket.description: Represents a provisional valet ticket for users without an account.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ticket. Read-only.

pin.description: A temporary PIN for the user to access their ticket information.

location_id.description: The ID of the location where the ticket was issued.

CrudResult.description: Standard response for create, update, and delete operations.

Status.description: Represents the status of an operation.

result.description: A more detailed result of the operation.

message.description: A human-readable message about the operation.

id.description: The unique identifier for the location.

post.description: This endpoint allows a new client to create their user profile.

idToken.description: Firebase authentication ID token for the new user.

id.description: The ID of the user to retrieve. Should match the authenticated user.

200.description: An array of client profiles matching the search criteria.

post.summary: Link a provisional ticket to a client account
